description: Tender search from Tenders Electronic Daily (TED). Search public European procurement notices by classification code, buyer country, notice type, keyword, value, and publication window. This independent app is provided by Telemark Digital and is not affiliated with or endorsed by TED, the European Union, or the Publications Office of the European Union. Each request returns a bounded, minimized JSON preview. Results are informational, not legal or procurement advice. The app accepts public notice filters only and does not solicit personal data. No external account, payment method, or purchase is required. Telemark Digital funds the free searches, subject to daily and shared monthly capacity limits.
